what: The remote-plant plan assumed main already configured the shared 119120 seed. It does not. The recorded unit checks used the installed runtime defaults.
cause: A future setup on the settings pair was treated as current main configuration.
fix: Corrected the private approved plan to describe the actual installed defaults, keeping all 100-run counts and adding no seed override. The shared setup remains separate. This changes no current seed policy and grants no actual adapter or product proof.
test: Read current vitest setup and both property-library configurations before attributing a fixed seed to a passing run.
